title: Riemannian Penrose Inequality for Manifolds with Corners via Non-Linear Potential Theory
summary: We present a new proof of the Positive Mass Theorem and the Riemannian Penrose Inequality for three-dimensional asymptotically flat Riemannian manifolds whose metrics fail to be $C^1$ across a hypersurface $Σ$, first proven by Miao and McCormick-Miao, respectively. Unlike these approaches, ours recovers these results directly, without relying on their original formulations for smooth metrics.
